name: Victor Reeves

tenures.finisher: New Orleans Press (a Shooting Star Press into a Guillotine Leg Drop)
signature_moves: Bourbon Street Slam (Air Plane Spin into a F-5)
tenures.source: his own CGI bio card (promotions/gmwe/archive/bio-card-victor-reeves.html)
